text:
Priya Nair: Idea: run a 'refapp roadshow' - three 30-min sessions over two weeks: quickstart tutorial, benchmark walkthrough, hands-on office hours. Target: devs who fork the repo.
Jenna Li: Love that. Keep sessions short and code-first. We should surface one clear starter task for attendees to complete during office hours.
Sam Torres: For promo, split into: community newsletter, dev twitter thread, and short TikTok-style demo clip for LinkedIn. Small paid push on X for targeted dev audiences.
Priya Nair: CTA hierarchy: 1) Clone repo 2) Run quickstart 3) Compare perf with our benchmark notebook 4) Join office hours.
Alex Rivera: Tech flow for signups: Netlify form -> Zapier -> Airtable -> HubSpot contact create -> add tag refapp_roadshow. Also create GH issue when someone adds the "needs demo" checkbox.
Eden Park: I'll make a compact hero that reads "Build, measure, ship: Redwood Refapp". Need benchmark chart mock and a 10s GIF of local dev loop.
Jenna Li: Workshop plan: mini-lecture 8m, guided lab 15m, recap + push to GH 7m. Provide Docker + instructions for quickstart.
Priya Nair: Messaging draft snippets: 
- Email subject: "Get your LLM feature shipped in a day \u2014 join our refapp roadshow"
- Slack post: "Hands-on refapp mini-workshop this Thurs. Fork, run, ship. Seats limited."
- Tweet: "New refapp + benchmarks -> see how a few config knobs cut costs 2x. Live demo Thurs."
Sam Torres: Routing: add utm_campaign=refapp_roadshow, utm_source=community and a hidden field for "github_handle". We'll use that to prioritize leads.
Alex Rivera: Small infra note: add a GitHub Action that runs the quickstart smoke test on PRs to the refapp repo. Example: 
```yaml
name: smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: docker-compose up -d --build
      - run: pytest tests/smoke.py
```
Eden Park: For benchmark transparency, include a "how we measured" section with hardware, concurrency, prompt set. We should publish raw data CSV for reproducibility.
Jenna Li: Can devrel host the office hours? I can run the guided lab and handle live debugging.
Priya Nair: Assignments: Jenna -> workshop content; Eden -> hero + GIF + charts; Alex -> signups + Action + HubSpot; Sam -> promo plan + paid budget; I will own email copy + landing page.
Marketing Bot: Reminder: weekly launch checklist due Tue 9am. Add tasks to project board.
Sam Torres: Budget ask: $500 for X targeted ads + $200 creative boost for LinkedIn posts. Approve?
Priya Nair: Approve. Sam post budget to the shared drive and tag finance.
Alex Rivera: I'll stub the HubSpot form and webhook today. Quick test endpoint: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://hooks.example.com/hubspot -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"roadshow-test@example.com","utm_campaign":"refapp_roadshow"}'
```
Eden Park: I have draft assets by EOD tomorrow. Will add to the Figma board and link in this thread.
Jenna Li: Final ask: can we include a small prize (credit code) for top 3 PRs that improve perf? Drives contributions.
Priya Nair: Good call — let's do $250 in credits split across winners. I'll add to the landing page.
Marketing Bot: Event created in calendar: Refapp Roadshow Week 1 - Quickstart (Thu 17:00 UTC). Invite list synced.
Priya Nair: Thanks team — I'll open the GH project and tag owners. Keep updates in this thread.
